name: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec)
binary_resolution: newest candidate whose `codex features list` loads ~/.codex/config.toml (Homebrew 0.147 cannot)
plan_source: OPENSWARM_CODEX_PLAN env or policy codex.plan; opt-in: chatgpt_plan_type claim of ~/.codex/auth.json id_token (local_sources.codex_auth_plan, decoded locally, never sent)
quota_source: rate_limits lines in ~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl (local_sources.codex_sessions; per limit_id, primary/secondary windows)
sessionPolicy: keep (codex rollout retained; resumable with `codex exec resume <thread_id>`)
streaming_events: item.started command_execution is emitted BEFORE a command runs -> real-time RISK alerts
